core.title: Blacksmith Hand Towel Ring, Fusion TR-E2

text.description_html:
Fusion TR-E2, Blacksmith Towel Ring

The Blacksmith Hand Towel Ring is a great way to keep those towels off the floor and out of the sink. It is very easy to install and comes with all the necessary mounting hardware. We like the Blacksmith Towel Ring for its interesting style that is modern without being square and chrome (if you have been looking for bathroom hardware lately you know what we mean). Choose from antique copper, antique pewter, or oil rubbed bronze finishes

Also Available Matching: Fusion TB-E2 Blacksmith Towel Bar, Fusion PH-E2 Blacksmith Toilet Paper Holder, and Fusion RH-E2 Blacksmith Robe Hook

Features and Specifications of the Blacksmith Series Towel Ring:

  • Mount Length: 4"
  • Mount Width: 2-3/4"
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware.

Sold Individually
